subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers close this protected PR as superseded by merged macOS onboarding work, or ask for a narrow rebase that fixes the remaining security/auth findings?
rationale: The `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, current main already owns much of the user-facing setup flow, and the remaining branch risk is a product/security/upgrade choice rather than a safe deterministic repair.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR after a maintainer confirms https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 cover the desired macOS setup direction and no unique branch work should be preserved.

options.title: Request Narrow Rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, drop superseded installer/onboarding churn, fix the credentialed probe and setup-gate regressions, and add real macOS proof.

options.title: Sponsor Adoption
options.body: A maintainer can adopt only selected pieces from this branch into a fresh protected branch if there is a unique UX detail worth preserving.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after a maintainer confirms https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 cover the desired macOS setup direction and no unique branch work should be preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged current-main onboarding work that most directly supersedes this PR and is the clearest owner for the close-versus-rebase choice.
